paragraphs: I'm writing to apply for the Product Engineer (Full-stack, AI-assisted) role at Cloudstaff. I'm a full-stack .NET/React engineer who already works the way this role is scoped — owning features end-to-end from planning through testing and handover, and using AI coding tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as part of my daily workflow rather than as an experiment.

At Delta Insurance, I own end-to-end feature development on a .NET Core microservices backend paired with a React frontend, from implementation through deployment, and provide technical governance by reviewing peer Senior Developers' architecture and code for SOLID alignment. I use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, and helped establish developer guidelines via 'claude.md' to integrate agentic AI tools into the team's workflow. I also author automated test coverage — Jest and Testing Library unit tests plus Playwright end-to-end tests run via MCP integration with Claude Code — and run manual testing across dev, UAT, and production environments.

Earlier, at Beeline, I collaborated with cross-functional Agile teams to ship scalable full-stack solutions and built a secure RESTful API for background check integrations handling sensitive data for global enterprise clients — experience that maps directly to the PR-based, Git/CI-CD workflow and Agile delivery cadence your team runs on.

I've worked fully remote with Philippines-based teams throughout my career, so the work-from-home, morning-shift arrangement fits my existing routine. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Cloudstaff's product team and am available to start on short notice. Thank you for your time and consideration.
